description: Check file names against your naming convention and get the fixed name. Send up to 50 file names and the pattern: which parts in which order (date, client, title, version), the separator, the date format (YYYY-MM-DD or YYYYMMDD), the version form (v01), the title form (lower-case words joined by '-'), your client codes and allowed extensions. Get back, per name: ok, fix (with the suggested name and every change made) or cannot_fix (with the reason: an ambiguous date such as 04-05-2026, no client code found, an extension not allowed, a suggested name that would collide with another file). Also flags characters Windows does not allow, reserved names such as CON, names ending in a space or dot, spaces, non-ASCII letters and over-long names. File names only: do not send names of people, emails or ID numbers (they are refused when they look like them). Answer fields: ok, verdict, result, rule, does_not, sources, observation, signature, verify. Errors: ok false with the reason (bad input, too large, hourly limit). Free. No model, no network, nothing you send is stored by the tool, and every answer is signed with LLPRO's key (check it at https://llpro.ai/file-name-check). Not legal, tax or financial advice.

client_codes.description: Your client codes (up to 200). When sent, only these count as client codes; matched without regard to case.

items.description: Client code, 2 to 12 letters or digits (shown in capitals).

date_format.description: Date form (ISO 8601 extended YYYY-MM-DD, the default, or basic YYYYMMDD).

default_client.description: Optional client code to use when a name has none (for a folder that holds one client's files).

default_version.description: Version to use when a name has none (default 1).

extensions.description: Optional allowed extensions without the dot (for example pdf, docx). When sent, every name needs one of them.

fallback_date.description: Optional date to use when a name has no date (for example the date the files were made), YYYY-MM-DD.

max_length.description: Longest allowed file name in characters, extension included (default 255).

names.description: File names to check (up to 50), each up to 255 characters, with the extension, without the folder path.

numeric_date_order.description: How to read dates like 04-05-2026 in the old names: unknown (default; ambiguous ones are not fixed), month_first (US) or day_first.

parts.description: Parts of the pattern in order (default date, client, title, version), each at most once.

title_case.description: Title words in lower case (default) or as written.

version_digits.description: Digits in the version number, zero-padded (default 2: v01).

version_prefix.description: Letters before the version number (default v).

name: file_name_check
title: File Naming Convention Check
